stack.subheading: Every tool mastered is a weapon in my arsenal. I leverage best-in-class technologies to build performant, scalable, and maintainable applications. Below are the core components of my current tech stack.

items.detail: App Router, RSC, ISR with on-demand revalidation. Edge middleware for geo-routing and A/B experimentation.
Eloquent ORM with model observers for domain events. Horizon for queue monitoring and Telescope for debugging.
Pygame for 2D game development, leveraging Python's simplicity for rapid prototyping. Also used for build scripts and automation.
Declarative UI with @Observable macro, structured concurrency via async/await, and Core Data + CloudKit sync.
Modern Android development with Jetpack Compose for declarative UI, Kotlin Coroutines for async, and Room for local data persistence.
ACID-compliant storage with GIN indexes for JSONB queries. Connection pooling via PgBouncer at 200 concurrent.
Semantic HTML5, modern CSS with Flexbox and Grid, and vanilla JavaScript for DOM manipulation and interactivity.
Experience with Git workflows, branching strategies, and GitHub for code review and continuous integration.
Flutter for building natively compiled applications for mobile, web, and desktop from a single codebase.
